issues.description: Method name mismatch for the Farm song method: the problem statement (UML and Part 3 text) refers to a method named printFarmSong(), whereas both the template and the solution implement a method named singFarmSong(). This naming inconsistency between specification and code will confuse students (they may look for printFarmSong in the template or tests) and can cause automated tests or example code to fail or not compile if they reference the other name.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) update the problem statement (UML and text) to refer to singFarmSong() instead of printFarmSong(), or (B) rename the method in both the template and solution from singFarmSong() to printFarmSong() (and update any internal calls, comments, and tests). Ensure the chosen name is used consistently in the UML, textual instructions, template code, solution code, and any tests or example Main code.

issues.description: The exercise concept is the Farm class method that plays/prints the Old MacDonald song. The problem statement (UML and task text) refers to this method as printFarmSong() (UML: problem_statement.md line 20; task text: problem_statement.md line 112). However, the template implementation declares a public method named singFarmSong() (template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java, lines 9-11) and the solution also implements singFarmSong() (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java, lines 59-64). Students will be confused which method they should implement or call: following the textual instruction and implementing printFarmSong() would not match the provided template/stub and the solution uses singFarmSong(), causing a mapping gap between requirement and code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update the problem statement (UML and task text) to refer to singFarmSong() so it matches the template and solution, or (B) rename the template and solution methods from singFarmSong() to printFarmSong() (and update the private helper name(s) or any callers accordingly). Prefer updating the problem statement to singFarmSong() if the code and tests already use that name, otherwise rename code to printFarmSong() everywhere.
